biotools.summary: BRANCHSNV reports strict clade-exclusive nucleotide markers separately from nucleotide substitutions reconstructed on a selected edge of a rooted phylogenetic tree using equal-cost Sankoff parsimony, while retaining ambiguity across globally optimal reconstructions. It supports conventional and transposed nucleotide NEXUS matrices and produces deterministic, provenance-aware outputs.

function.cmd:
branchsnv find \
  --alignment alignment.nex \
  --tree tree.nwk \
  --outgroup-file outgroup_tips.txt \
  --clade-tips clade_tips.txt \
  --mode both \
  --output branch_snvs.tsv \
  --members-output branch_members.txt \
  --report branchsnv_report.json
function.note: Interrogates one selected branch of a rooted phylogeny, reporting strict clade-exclusive nucleotide states separately from substitutions reconstructed on the focal edge using equal-cost Sankoff parsimony.

biotools.name: BRANCHSNV
